sections.heading: Project overview
paragraphs: P.I.T.C.H. Market Master is a gamified business learning experience designed to immerse learners in a simulated marketplace environment.

The project involved transforming school-provided educational material into a structured, engaging and interactive digital learning experience. Rather than simply transferring existing content into presentation slides, I organised the material into lessons, designed the learner-facing content, developed the visual learning environment and built the interactive elements that guide learners through the experience.
The final product brings together visual storytelling, simulated business scenarios, interactive activities, decision-making exercises and game-inspired learning elements.

sections.heading: The challenge
sections.intro: The initial material was provided in a raw format and needed further organisation and development before it could become an engaging digital learning experience. The challenge was to turn it into a cohesive learning environment that would:
items: Organise educational content into a logical lesson structure.
Present information in an engaging and accessible format.
Maintain consistency across a large multi-screen learning experience.
Incorporate interactive navigation and learner-controlled interactions.
Create an immersive simulation environment using visual storytelling and gamification.
Feel cohesive rather than like a collection of disconnected slides.

sections.heading: Final deliverable

The project shows how I take existing educational content, organise it for digital delivery and turn it into a complete learner-facing experience through content design, visual storytelling, interaction design and eLearning development.
